title: Static font CORS documentation 89fe535be8: font-policy
value: `nginx-static.conf` sends `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *` on fonts (`woff`, `woff2`, `ttf`, `otf`, `eot`) only, so pages in sandboxed frames (origin `null`) can load them, as on GitHub Pages; `self migrate` adds that location to sites rendered before 1.24.0.

title: Static font CORS documentation 89fe535be8: migration
value:
`self update` runs `self migrate`, which adds the font location to static
sites rendered by earlier versions (a backup of each config is kept next to
it, and the old config is restored if `nginx -t` fails).
